reason: My spreadsheet, the whiteboard and Xero do the job and cost me next to nothing, so I'm not paying four hundred a month to move everything over, least of all to a company with zero customers.
objection: Moving every booking, driver and vehicle record across while I'm on the phones and driving runs myself sounds like a nightmare. If this new outfit folds or the app falls over mid-season, my whole schedule goes with it.
would_change_my_mind: If they migrated all my existing spreadsheets for me in the quiet season, gave me a free first few months, and I could talk to another coach operator my size already running on it.
